difficultyRationale: Tests a compile-time restriction specific to multi-catch alternatives that is easy to miss when reasoning only from normal catch ordering.
prompt: Which statement about the alternatives in a multi-catch parameter such as `catch (A | B ex)` is correct?
explanation: It is a compile-time error if one alternative in a multi-catch is a subtype of another alternative. The alternatives must not be related by subclassing in that way.

options.text: One alternative may be a subclass of another as long as it appears first.
options.explanation: Ordering does not make subtype-related alternatives legal inside the same multi-catch parameter.

options.text: No alternative may be a subtype of another alternative.
options.explanation: The language rejects subtype-related alternatives in the same multi-catch parameter.

options.text: All alternatives must have the same direct superclass.
options.explanation: There is no requirement that all alternatives share the same direct superclass.

options.text: Only unchecked exception types may be combined.
options.explanation: Multi-catch may combine checked exception types as well, provided the other rules are satisfied.
